text: Show that C_P − C_V = R for an ideal gas.

points.text: At constant volume, heat raises only the internal energy, so dU = nC_V dT.
At constant pressure, nC_P dT = dU + P dV.
For an ideal gas, P dV = nR dT.
Substituting gives C_P − C_V = R.
